correctness.rationale: Explicit four disjoint rotation classes and reverse ordering prove exact transfer for all primitive cyclically 11-free inputs. The transfer segments give BWT_0 recurrence, BWT_1 all zeros, and exactly two new linear runs at each level k>=3. Base BWT(W_2)=1000. Direct and cyclic suffix-doubling checkers independently verify finite instances but are not invoked as infinite proofs.
